prospective_contract.algorithm: Only raw 4-byte single-channel positive stride8 row compaction: two unaligned 256-bit loads compact even words to eight contiguous output words. Vector block requires >=9 remaining logical pixels, scalar tail <=8. Runtime SIMD eligibility hoisted once; generic channel/fill/row paths unchanged. Negative row/image strides unchanged. Integer operations only. No extra allocation.
